name: UCI Mushroom Database
description: The UCI Mushroom dataset is a classic machine learning benchmark for rule induction and binary categorical classification. Donated by Jeff Schlimmer in 1987 from the Audubon Society Field Guide to North American Mushrooms, it comprises 8,124 hypothetical mushroom samples described by 22 nominal physical attributes and classified as definitely edible or poisonous.
